declarations.description: Headless, WAI-ARIA accessible pagination control — a windowed page-item model (numbers + ellipses), prev/next bounds, roving keyboard navigation, scoped slots, and a two-way `modelValue` page binding.
declarations.name: Pagination

members.name: modelValue
members.description: The 1-based current page (two-way model). Clamped into `[1, totalPages]`. Bind it with `r-model:modelValue` / `v-model:modelValue` / `modelValue` + `onModelValueChange`; it is also the Angular ControlValueAccessor control value.

members.name: totalPages
members.description: Explicit total page count. When provided (> 0) it takes precedence over `total` + `pageSize`. Use it when the backend already reports the page count.

members.name: total
members.description: Total item count. Combined with `pageSize` to derive the page count (`ceil(total / pageSize)`) when `totalPages` is not given.

members.name: pageSize
members.description: Items per page. Combined with `total` to derive the page count when `totalPages` is not given.

members.name: siblingCount
members.description: Number of page buttons shown on each side of the current page (the sibling window). Larger values show more context around the current page.

members.name: boundaryCount
members.description: Number of page buttons always shown at each boundary (the first and last `boundaryCount` pages), regardless of the current page.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disable the entire control — every page button and the prev/next controls become non-interactive and are marked `aria-disabled`.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name for the surrounding `<nav>` landmark (its `aria-label`). Defaults to `"Pagination"`.

members.name: goto
members.description: Go to a specific 1-based page; the argument is clamped into `[1, totalPages]`. Emits `change` unless the target equals the current page.

members.name: next
members.description: Advance to the next page (no-op at the last page). Emits `change` on success.

members.name: prev
members.description: Go back to the previous page (no-op at the first page). Emits `change` on success.

members.name: first
members.description: Jump to the first page (page 1). Emits `change` unless already there.

members.name: last
members.description: Jump to the last page (the effective `totalPages`). Emits `change` unless already there.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired whenever the current page changes (a page button, prev/next, or a programmatic `goto`/`next`/`prev`/`first`/`last`). Payload `{ page }` — the new clamped 1-based page. Not fired when the target page equals the current page.

events.name: model-value-change
events.description: Fired with the updated `modelValue` (`event.detail`) when it changes.

slots.name: prevControl
slots.description: Scoped slot — props: disabled, goto, page.

slots.name: item
slots.description: Scoped slot — props: page, selected, goto.

slots.name: nextControl
slots.description: Scoped slot — props: disabled, goto, page.
